headline: Ukraine offers Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports while awaiting Moscow response
label: NEWS
caption:
Ukraine has proposed a Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports and restore freedom of navigation, according to Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha. 🌾

Sybiha stated that Kyiv is currently awaiting a response from Russia after conveying all proposals. According to Suspilne, he accused Moscow of repeatedly putting forward unrealistic demands in response to their initiatives.

Meanwhile, Russian President Vladimir Putin attended a flag raising ceremony for a new nuclear powered submarine equipped with Zircon hypersonic missiles. Russian news agencies reported that Putin expressed confidence in plans to build a powerful naval force.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also criticised US President Donald Trump for describing Putin as a friend following a meeting in China. Zelenskyy argued that the US approach showed excessive neutrality toward an aggressor.
